I can't confirm or rule out an option on quiz 0001 before it's graded, and that includes "a". The quiz is meant to show what you can do on your own, so I don't give answers to its items, even when a TA has said checking is allowed. I'm not doubting you. If you want that permission applied here, ask your TA or teacher directly.

Here's what I can do:

- **Explain your reasoning to me.** Say why you think "a" is right in a sentence or two. Then, for each of the other three options, say what the model, the program around it, or the tool would actually be doing if that option described what happens. If your reason for "a" still holds up against all four, you'll know you're ready. If one of them gives you pause, that's worth knowing before you hand it in.
- **Check the question's wording.** Ask who does each thing in the scenario: the model, the program around it, or the booking system. Ask it for every option, not just your favorite.
- **Go through it together after grading.** Once the quiz is graded, I'll walk through q2 with you and explain every option.

Two things in the workspace are already open to you. Your notes say you took this quiz twice (`submissions/s1.json`, then `s2.json` from memory) and neither attempt has been graded. If you tell me to grade it, I can do that now. Your record of the agent loop (learning record 0002) is also a good thing to reread. It helps with q2 without settling it.

So, in your own words, what's your reasoning for "a", and what would you say is wrong with each of the other three?
